+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.parse
+import urllib.request
+
+
+DEEPL_API_URL = "https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate"
+
+
+def _escape_text(text):
+    return (
+        text.replace("&", "&")
+        .replace("<", "<")
+        .replace(">", ">")
+        .replace('"', """)
+    )
+
+
+def _split_markup(text):
+    parts = []
+    buf = []
+    in_tag = False
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(text):
+        ch = text[i]
+        if ch == "<":
+            if buf:
+                parts.append((False, "".join(buf)))
+                buf = []
+            in_tag = True
+            buf.append(ch)
+        elif ch == ">" and in_tag:
+            buf.append(ch)
+            parts.append((True, "".join(buf)))
+            buf = []
+            in_tag = False
+        else:
+            buf.append(ch)
+        i += 1
+    if buf:
+        parts.append((in_tag, "".join(buf)))
+    return parts
+
+
+def _translate_text_deepl(text, target_lang, source_lang=None):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY") or os.environ.get("DEEPL_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY or DEEPL_API_KEY is required")
+    data = {"text": text, "target_lang": target_lang}
+    if source_lang:
+        data["source_lang"] = source_lang
+    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode("utf-8")
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        DEEPL_API_URL,
+        data=body,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"DeepL-Auth-Key {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
+            payload = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(exc.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")) from exc
+    return payload["translations"][0]["text"]
+
+
+def translate_markup(text, target_lang, source_lang=None):
+    parts = _split_markup(text)
+    out = []
+    for is_tag, part in parts:
+        if is_tag:
+            out.append(part)
+        elif part:
+            translated = _translate_text_deepl(part, target_lang, source_lang)
+            out.append(_escape_text(translated))
+    return "".join(out)
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
+    if len(argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: translate_markup.py TARGET_LANG TEXT [SOURCE_LANG]")
+    target_lang = argv[0]
+    text = argv[1]
+    source_lang = argv[2] if len(argv) > 2 else None
+    sys.stdout.write(translate_markup(text, target_lang, source_lang))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: batch_translate.py
+import os
+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def batch_translate(strings: List[str], target_language: str = "Spanish") -> List[str]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])
+    response = client.chat.completions.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        messages=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "Translate each input string into the target language. Preserve order and return one translation per line, with no extra text.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"Target language: {target_language}\n\nInputs:\n" + "\n".join(strings),
+            },
+        ],
+        temperature=0,
+    )
+    text = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
+    translations = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines()]
+    if len(translations) != len(strings):
+        raise ValueError("Translation count did not match input count")
+    return translations
*** End Patch
